gloss: to win through; to survive to the end

definitions.gloss: to win through; to survive to the end; to advance by winning
definitions.explanation: To keep winning through successive rounds of competition and advance to the end. Also used figuratively for overcoming a series of challenges to achieve final success.

examples.japanese: {予選|よせん}を{勝|か}ち{抜|ぬ}く。
examples.english: To win through the preliminary rounds.

examples.japanese: {厳|きび}しい{競争|きょうそう}を{勝|か}ち{抜|ぬ}いて{優勝|ゆうしょう}した。
examples.english: They won through the fierce competition and took the championship.

examples.japanese: この{業界|ぎょうかい}で{勝|か}ち{抜|ぬ}くためには、{常|つね}に{新|あたら}しいアイデアが{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: To survive in this industry, you always need new ideas.

notes:
A compound verb formed from {勝|か}つ (to win) and {抜|ぬ}く (to go through to the end). The {抜|ぬ}く element adds the nuance of continuing through to completion — not just winning once, but winning repeatedly to reach the final goal.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {予選|よせん}を{勝|か}ち{抜|ぬ}く: to win through the preliminaries
- {競争|きょうそう}を{勝|か}ち{抜|ぬ}く: to survive the competition
- {選挙|せんきょ}を{勝|か}ち{抜|ぬ}く: to win through an election
- {勝|か}ち{抜|ぬ}き{戦|せん}: elimination tournament; knockout competition

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {勝|か}ち{残|のこ}る: to win and survive — emphasizes surviving rather than advancing
- {勝|か}ち{進|すす}む: to advance by winning — emphasizes forward progress through brackets
- {生|い}き{残|のこ}る: to survive — broader, not limited to competition

GRAMMAR:
Godan verb (く row). The noun form {勝|か}ち{抜|ぬ}き is commonly used as a modifier: {勝|か}ち{抜|ぬ}き{戦|せん} (knockout tournament).
